name: session-pulse
description: See at a glance which of your sessions needs you, which are working and which are done. A board pane (/pulse) lists every session on this machine with a status mark left of its name (needs you, working, ready, failed, idle, offline), sorted so the ones waiting on you come first, with how long each has waited or run. A one-line band above the prompt counts the other sessions and names the one that has waited longest; it hides when nothing is going on. /pulse next names the session to look at. Optional (/pulse pin on): a session pins itself in the sidebar while it waits on you and unpins after. On disk it keeps one small status file per session in ~/.claude/session-pulse/live (title, status words, tool name, times; no prompt, thinking or answer). Sends nothing out.
